purpose: Second-round visual design directions for discussion.

images.title: Вариант 1 — светлый редакционный
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a truly exceptional art-directed desktop web interface for «альфа.поток», a small-business loan workspace in the visual spirit of Alfa-Bank. A refined second-round design proposal by a top-tier digital design studio, unusually strong composition and typography, realistic implementable UI. Single sharp front-on desktop screenshot, landscape 16:10, no device frame, no collage of pages, no presentation labels. Russian language. No purple, no gradients across the entire background, no generic credit-card hero, no glassmorphism UI, no clutter, no giant financial clipart. Beautiful precise Swiss-inspired typographic hierarchy with high-quality Cyrillic sans serif, deep black, warm white, small vivid Alfa red accents, sophisticated 20px corners, hairline rules, immense compositional confidence. Canvas soft warm #F6F5F3, white header. Slim refined header at top: understated red underlined А mark plus black/red wordmark «альфа.поток»; nav «Обзор», «Финансирование», «Мои заявки», «Для бизнеса»; right clean notification icon and compact «Пекарня Зерно» company switch. Beneath a very small breadcrumb «КАБИНЕТ ПРЕДПРИНИМАТЕЛЯ», then greeting «Иван, ваш бизнес может больше.» with proper natural kerning and a tiny date at far right. Main asymmetric composition: broad left hero panel 68% width with editorial magazine quality. Large left-aligned headline «Большие планы.
Следующий шаг.» the second line red. Small calm support text «Финансирование для того, что вы задумали.» A refined substantial red button «Подобрать решение» with a thin arrow. Right half of hero: beautiful original lifestyle photograph of a modern artisan bakery in soft morning sunlight, hands of a baker in a cream apron arranging bread, face not necessary, warm tactile genuine business context. Photograph art-directed as a large rounded rectangular crop, with one slim red translucent sculptural arc at the photograph edge, restrained and premium, not stock-photo aesthetic. Under hero text three small understated typographic benefits separated by fine vertical rules, not separate floating cards: «Онлайн-заявка», «Понятные этапы», «Всё в одном кабинете». Right column 29% width a white elegant active application panel, small label «СЕЙЧАС В РАБОТЕ», «Оборотный кредит», big «2 000 000 ₽», pale amber small pill «На рассмотрении», three refined vertical step rows, current step red; bottom clean black secondary button «Открыть заявку». Beneath the main composition a crisp horizontal summary band with fine separators, «1 активная заявка», «24 месяца», «Профиль заполнен 100%». Lower screen two editorial feature rows: «Решения для вашего бизнеса» with three minimal product tiles using tiny line icons and exact labels «На закупки», «На оборудование», «На кассовый разрыв». One tasteful thin footer «Демонстрационный прототип · Альфа.Поток». All content perfectly aligned on a disciplined 12-column grid, no excessive tiny explanatory text. Outstanding mature bank website UX, polished hover-ready controls, exquisite optical balance. Exact Russian labels should be readable. No unsupported approval promises or real banking offers.

images.title: Вариант 2 — выразительный фирменный
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an award-caliber art-directed desktop website concept for Russian small-business credit workspace «альфа.поток», strongly inspired by Alfa-Bank's confident contemporary red/black identity. This is an improved, extremely polished second-round design, not a generic banking dashboard. Single complete flat front-on landscape 16:10 screen, high-resolution clean readable Russian type, no browser chrome, no device frame, no collage of separate pages, no watermarks. Visually different from a standard 3-column card dashboard. Palette is warm white #FAFAF8, saturated Alfa red #EF3124, near-black #19191B, silver accents only. One confident bright red feature panel, otherwise light and airy UI. Strong contemporary Cyrillic grotesk typography, huge headlines with controlled letter spacing, elegantly small uppercase category labels, generous gutters, crisp thin line icons. Header: red underlined А brand mark and «альфа.поток», horizontal nav «Главная», «Финансирование», «Мои заявки», «Новости», right notifications and «Пекарня Зерно». Under header an understated personal introduction row «Здравствуйте, Иван» and date «22 октября 2026». Main signature hero is an architectural asymmetrical bento layout, not dozens of boxes: at left a dominant red rectangular panel with 24px corner radius and huge beautiful white headline «Растите.
Мы рядом.» Short light supporting text about business financing, refined white button «Подобрать финансирование» with a small arrow. Right portion of red panel has a sculptural brushed-silver upward arch that has structural depth and catches red reflections, with one dark-red glass geometric step, original elegant premium product rendering, no credit cards or random coins. Connected to the hero on its right, a smaller off-white application dashboard panel with huge black «2 000 000 ₽», label «Ваша заявка», title «Оборотный кредит», amber «На рассмотрении», a clean 5-segment progress rail with 2 completed black segments and 1 active red segment, text «Оцениваем возможности бизнеса» and slim arrow action. Below hero a clean editorial section «Что нужно вашему бизнесу?» with three horizontal choices that are understated white panels, black titles «Пополнить оборотку», «Купить оборудование», «Закрыть кассовый разрыв», tiny original red line icons and diagonal corner arrows. At screen bottom an elegant wide business story strip: small beautiful natural photographic crop of a small bakery counter and coffee, headline «Бизнес начинается с идеи.
Растёт — с хорошего плана.», small link «Читать истории бизнеса». Whitespace, careful alignment and restraint are essential: cohesive 12-column grid, minimal shadows, functional and credible financial product design. Small footer «Демонстрационный прототип». No excessive decoration, no rainbow tiles, no template SaaS look, no fake guarantees of approval. The dominant hero red must feel luxurious, energetic and balanced with plenty of white, not overwhelming.
